about:
Established in Sandy Hook, Connecticut, SMT Corp. has supported organizations reliant on reliable electronic components for over 25 years, with a track record serving aerospace and defense primes since 1995. The company operates a U.S. headquarters in Sandy Hook and a wholly owned subsidiary, SMT Labs UK, in Rochester, Kent, extending its accredited testing capabilities into Europe.

SMT Corp. provides electronic component sourcing, authentication, testing, qualification, and inventory management services. Its capabilities include hard-to-find and obsolete component sourcing, independent open-market procurement, advanced laboratory testing to MIL-STD-750 and MIL-STD-883, counterfeit detection per AS6171 High-Risk Level 2, and excess and end-of-life asset evaluation and resale. The company holds AS6171 HRL2 accreditation—one of only two facilities worldwide with that designation—and DLA Qualified Testing Suppliers List status for testing untraceable products.

The company serves defense, aerospace, space, critical infrastructure, medical, telecommunications, data infrastructure, and high-performance computing markets. Customers include defense and aerospace prime contractors, government agencies, and organizations managing difficult-to-source, obsolete, or high-risk electronic components across North America, Europe, and global markets.

SMT Corp. differentiates itself through a secure chain of custody from sourcing to delivery, compliance with AS9120, AS6081, AS6171, and ISO/IEC 17025 quality systems, and a mission to support customers across the full component lifecycle with reliable sourcing, testing, and authentication services for mission-critical operations.
